approval: User selected: No default — require an explicit region tag. Difficulty follows the configured facet.

fields.region: Exact native region name, case sensitive

resolution: Search the caster current region then its parents; closest explicit tag wins. Never derive Act from the corpse or monster level.
untagged: Decline before animation/payment/corpse reservation. No default is supplied. Revalidate at release; removing a tag cancels output without refunding an already paid cast.
difficulty: SummonDifficulties.For(caster.Map), using existing facet-difficulties.json policy (undesignated physical facets are Normal).
scope: Find Potion only; other skills retain existing area policies.
sourceFallback: Legacy generic item-code zero is documented but unsupported in the native potion factory. Required valid area context prevents reaching it.
assets: Identified UO search cry/flash placeholders. Final effects/audio and talent/hotkey icons are separate asset work.
